control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at HT-9006 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9006 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9006 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 15 November 2020 an incident occurred on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
